# Clinic booking portal

*Client industry: healthcare | Completed: 2024-05-17 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p00*

## The problem
The client was a dental clinic taking bookings by phone.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using a component-based single-page frontend, a statically typed frontend codebase, a JavaScript backend, a relational database with proper migrations, utility-first styling. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project moved 70% of bookings online in six weeks.
